input.summary: Replace the immediate-cessation/deletion clause with a six-month transition assistance right at then-current rates, and anchor the 30-day data return to expiry or termination.
input.comment: [Playbook] Section 11.1 cuts off all assistance and deletes Customer Data immediately with no export, which is our walk-away position and contradicts 11.2 and 11.3, so we replaced it with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates. We also anchored the 30-day return in 11.2 to expiry or termination; the existing machine-readable format and certified deletion after return are unchanged.

ops.oldText: 11.1 Immediately on termination Vendor shall discontinue all assistance and permanently delete Customer Data without offering an export or migration support.
ops.newText: 11.1 On expiry or termination of this Agreement or any Order Form, Vendor shall, at Customer's request, provide transition assistance for up to six months at Vendor's then-current rates.

ops.oldText: Within thirty days after Customer's request, Vendor shall return
ops.newText: Within thirty days after expiry or termination or Customer's request, Vendor shall return
